modinfo.title: CD Palmar Pill Limit 3/2 (build 2026-09-23)
modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: Limits how many Palmar Pills you can carry: 3 Palmar Pills and 2 Refined Palmar Pills in total (vanilla 10 each). Lowers max_stack_count and turns on apply_max_stack_cap (the same total-carry cap the game uses for Refinement Tokens) in iteminfo. Built against game data 0.paver 020003000200e3cc19cb (2026-09-23 update); each change carries entry + rel_offset so DMM can re-anchor after future patches.

changes.label: Palmar Pill (RevivalItemPartialRecovery) apply_max_stack_cap: 0->1 (cap total held at 3)
Refined Palmar Pill (RevivalItem) apply_max_stack_cap: 0->1 (cap total held at 2)
